source_name: Electoral Geography Boundary Files (45th General Election) - Canada 2025
coverage: Canada; 2025 polling division, advance polling district, and riding boundaries
notes: The official 2025 geography package provides polygon boundaries and map services. It does not include the assigned voting building for each polling division.

The public lookup can expose polling-place information during an active election, but no reproducible post-election bulk 2025 poll-to-building coordinate table was found through this interface. A postal-code probe using M5V 3A8 returned the Spadina--Harbourfront district profile and last-election information, but no polling-place building/address. A second probe using a representative point from federal_2025|35100|1|election_day reverse-geocoded to M5X 2A1, and VIS required a full civic-address form before district resolution; it still did not expose a polling-place result through the tested post-election route.
